english.title: Fail to execute works within the time provided in a local authority notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required by a notice under section 99 of the Building Act 1984 to execute works at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) by **(..SPECIFY DATE..), failed to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(2)(b) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fail to execute works required
by local authority notice under section 99 of the Building Act 1984
within the time limited by the notice

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, having been required by a notice under section 99 of the Building Act 1984 to execute works at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) by **(..SPECIFY DATE..), failed to do so.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note: A further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues after conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
